xml_snippets.Title: MaintainOnly (PrisonerInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: maintain only
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Just feed the prisoner and provide for their basic needs, without attempting any other interaction.
xml_snippets.XML:
<PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

    <defName>MaintainOnly</defName>

    <label>maintain only</label>

    <listOrder>0</listOrder>

    <description>Just feed the prisoner and provide for their basic needs, without attempting any other interaction.</description>

  </PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

xml_snippets.Title: AttemptRecruit (PrisonerInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: recruit
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Wardens will attempt to recruit the prisoner. If the prisoner still has resistance, wardens will speak to them to reduce it.
xml_snippets.XML:
<PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

    <defName>AttemptRecruit</defName>

    <label>recruit</label>

    <listOrder>10</listOrder>

    <allowOnWildMan>False</allowOnWildMan>

    <description>Wardens will attempt to recruit the prisoner. If the prisoner still has resistance, wardens will speak to them to reduce it.</description>

    <hideIfNotRecruitable>true</hideIfNotRecruitable>

  </PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

xml_snippets.Title: ReduceResistance (PrisonerInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: reduce resistance only
xml_snippets.Description Originale: If the prisoner still has resistance, wardens will speak to them to reduce it. No recruit attempts will be made.
xml_snippets.XML:
<PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

    <defName>ReduceResistance</defName>

    <label>reduce resistance only</label>

    <isChildInteraction>true</isChildInteraction>

    <listOrder>11</listOrder>

    <allowOnWildMan>False</allowOnWildMan>

    <description>If the prisoner still has resistance, wardens will speak to them to reduce it. No recruit attempts will be made.</description>

    <hideIfNotRecruitable>true</hideIfNotRecruitable>

  </PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

xml_snippets.Title: Release (PrisonerInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: release
xml_snippets.Description Originale: A warden will release the prisoner.

xml_snippets.Title: Execution (PrisonerInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: execute
xml_snippets.Description Originale: A warden will execute the prisoner on the spot by cutting. This can affect the mood of other prisoners and colonists.
xml_snippets.XML:
<PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

    <defName>Execution</defName>

    <label>execute</label>

    <listOrder>40</listOrder>

    <description>A warden will execute the prisoner on the spot by cutting. This can affect the mood of other prisoners and colonists.</description>

    <mustBeAwake>false</mustBeAwake>

  </PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

xml_snippets.Title: Enslave (PrisonerInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: enslave
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Wardens will threaten the prisoner to reduce their will. Once they have no will left, the warden will enslave them.
xml_snippets.XML:
<PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

    <defName>Enslave</defName>

    <label>enslave</label>

    <listOrder>25</listOrder>

    <description>Wardens will threaten the prisoner to reduce their will. Once they have no will left, the warden will enslave them.</description>

    <allowOnWildMan>false</allowOnWildMan>

  </PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

xml_snippets.Title: ReduceWill (PrisonerInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: reduce will only
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Wardens will threaten the prisoner to reduce their will, but won't enslave them.
xml_snippets.XML:
<PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

    <defName>ReduceWill</defName>

    <label>reduce will only</label>

    <isChildInteraction>true</isChildInteraction>

    <listOrder>26</listOrder>

    <description>Wardens will threaten the prisoner to reduce their will, but won't enslave them.</description>

    <allowOnWildMan>false</allowOnWildMan>

  </PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

xml_snippets.Title: Convert (PrisonerInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: convert
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Wardens will attempt to convert the prisoner to their ideoligion.
xml_snippets.XML:
<PrisonerInteractionModeDef>

    <defName>Convert</defName>

    <label>convert</label>

    <listOrder>28</listOrder>

    <description>Wardens will attempt to convert the prisoner to their ideoligion.</description>

    <allowInClassicIdeoMode>false</allowInClassicIdeoMode>

  </PrisonerInteractionModeDef>
